description: The destination name decides the role of two equally literal strings. signingKeyId is an identifier for runtime-generated material and cannot sign anything, while signingKey is the material itself and remains a hardcoded-secret finding. The exclusion is limited to an identifier suffix, so a differently ordered name such as idSigningKey is not silently treated as an identifier.

expected.note: key material remains reportable; only a destination ending in the identifier role is excluded
idSigningKey signs identifiers; id is not a suffix and does not reclassify the material as a key identifier
